description: lockFileMaintenance is on because Renovate's ordinary updates are driven by what Cargo.toml and package.json declare, and its OSV alerts are documented as direct-only. Neither reaches a purely transitive crate. Every advisory found in the 2026-08-30 audit sweep was against one: anyhow and rand via tauri, event-listener via keyring, and the yanked wasm-bindgen family via reqwest. None is declared here, and none of the first 23 Renovate PRs on this repository touched a crate that was not declared, so the drift had no owner but a manual sweep.

The weekly refresh gives it one. It pairs with the deny-warnings ratchet in src-tauri/.cargo/audit.toml: a lock-maintenance PR that pulls in a crate carrying an unlisted advisory fails the audit job rather than merging quietly. Such a PR needs a decision - take the fix, pin the crate, or add an entry naming the upstream owner and why it cannot be fixed here - not a rubber stamp.
